blind_target.title: Response latencies in discriminations of recency.
blind_target.evidence_quote: The classic ﬁnding from short-term relative JOR tasks is that correct response time (RT) depends on the lag to the more recent item but not to the less recent item (see Fig. 1, Muter, 1979; Hacker, 1980; Hockley, 1984).
blind_target.outcome_quote: This study replicated the classical ﬁnding in a relative JOR task that correct RT depends on the lag to the more recent probe but not on the lag to the less recent probe (Fig. 2b).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The paper explicitly replicates the classic correct-RT finding attributed jointly to these papers and confirms it in the discussion.

shipped_originals.title_o: Embarrassing Exposures in Online Social Networks: An Integrated Perspective of Privacy Invasion and Relationship Bonding

blind_target.evidence_quote: In this study, we carry out a methodological replication of the research done by Choi et al. (2015) published in Information System Research.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Our replication results show that whereas most of the hypotheses supported by the original results on behavioral responses replicate with high consistency (8 out of 12 hypotheses), the results that deal with the effects of network commonality on perceived privacy invasion and perceived relationship bonding did not replicate (4 out of 12 hypotheses).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly report behavioral-response agreement and network-commonality disagreement. A failed manipulation does not override their mixed comparisons. Full reference unavailable.

shipped_originals.title_o: A genome-wide association study in Chinese men identifies three risk loci for non-obstructive azoospermia
shipped_originals.authors_o: Hu; Xia; Guo; Dai; Li; Hu; Jiang; Lu; Wu; Yang; Li; Yao; Lu; Xiong; Li; Gui; Liu; Zhou; Shen; Wang; Sha

blind_target.evidence_quote: Recently, a Chinese genomewide association study (GWAS) identified four autosomal single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) loci as being significantly associated with risk factors for nonobstructive azoospermia (NOA; P < 5 × 10(-8)). In the present study, we performed a replication study on two Japanese cohorts from different institutions in order to evaluate whether SNP loci are associated with NOA.
blind_target.outcome_quote: None of the SNPs was significantly associated with NOA (P > 0.05).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Original four significant associations were retested, and none was significant. Three directional agreements are noted, but do not establish confirmation. Full discussion unavailable; uncertainty retained.

blind_target.title: Taking a hands-on approach: Apparent grasping ability scales the perception of object size.
blind_target.evidence_quote: We focused on the claim made by Linkenauger et al. (2011) that right-handed observers estimate the size of objects they intend to grasp in their right hand as smaller than objects they intend to grasp in their left hand because they perceive the grasping capacity of their right hand as greater than that of their left hand.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Thus we did not replicate the results of Linkenauger et al. (2011) because we failed to find the predicted influence of perceived action capacity on spatial perception.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall nonreplication verdict for the focal object size finding; successful preliminary hand asymmetry checks do not override it.
